articles.title: Bertelsmann Stiftung: Viele Langzeitarbeitslose sehen keine besseren Chancen durch Jobcenter

articles.image_title: Bertelsmann Stiftung: A waiting area can be seen inside of a Jobcenter in Duesseldorf-Mitte, western Germany, on August 25, 2017. The number of people out of work has halved in Germany since 2005, but a core of around 900,000 who have been looking for a job for more than a year have proved difficult to place. (Photo by PATRIK STOLLARZ / AFP) / TO GO WITH AFP STORY by Jean-Philippe LACOUR (Photo by PATRIK STOLLARZ/AFP via Getty Images)
